aboutParagraph1:
Founded in 1990 in Stara Zagora, TETRAEDAR is a Bulgarian company specializing in the production of high-end safes and banking, professional and personal equipment.

We combine our own production, tested technologies and individual approach to each project.
feature1Description: Products tested and certified by international security standards.
feature2Description: Production base in Stara Zagora with an area of 4500 sq. m.
feature3Description: Options for choosing locking mechanisms, sizes and additional protections.
partnersDescription: With extensive experience and hundreds of implemented projects in different industries, we build long-term partnerships based on quality solutions, technical expertise and reliable professional support.
